title: Grand Theft Auto Advance
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1416 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Action. Cash width assumed u32. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. PC mGBA sweep (boot, mash, walk; C2 gbaverify): health 100 -> 99 after a hit, cash earned 0 -> 25. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text:
A shoot / enter car, B run / accelerate, R lock weapon, L next weapon
Wanted stars rise with crimes
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Fists, pistol, Uzi, shotgun, flamethrower, rocket launcher, grenades, molotovs and more.
widgets.label: Arsenal

widgets.text:
Up to 6 stars: police, then SWAT, FBI and army.
Pay 'n' Spray garages wipe the wanted level.
widgets.label: Wanted level

widgets.text: Portland -> Staunton Island -> Shoreside Vale, opening as the story advances.
widgets.label: Islands

widgets.text:
Missions and side jobs pay cash.
Ammu-Nation sells weapons; hidden packages also add weapons at hideouts.
widgets.label: Money

widgets.text: Hidden packages, rampages and unique stunt jumps around the city.
widgets.label: Collectables

widgets.text: Work through each boss's missions to find out who killed Vinnie.
widgets.label: Goal
